This 11.11, get ready to give your home a serious comfort upgrade. For a limited time only, HomesToLife is offering an incredible **50% off all customised armchairs.**


Whether you love a cozy reading nook or want a statement piece to anchor your space, now’s your chance to make it yours — at half the price. Choose from a wide range of styles, fabrics, and colours to create a piece that perfectly fits your home and personality.


🛋️ **Here’s why you’ll love it:**


Enjoy 50% off all armchairs, including customisable options.


Choose from a wide selection of premium fabrics and leathers.


Personalise your comfort — because your home deserves the best.


📅 **Promotion Period:** 7- 23 November 2025 only


Don’t miss this flash sale — comfort this good won’t wait!


**Applicable to all Customised Recliner Sofa, Nursing Chair and Armchairs . T&Cs apply.*
